title: QVP and Mosadaqa: start with the right request
description: Different programme names do not automatically mean interchangeable requirements.
answer: Do not choose a programme from its name alone. Clarify whether the request concerns an academic certificate, a profession-related qualification check or a practical skills examination.

sections.title: Start with who is asking
sections.text: An employer, professional body, education institution or processing authority may use different terminology. Ask for the named programme, official link and purpose in writing.

sections.title: Academic certificate verification
sections.text: For a Mosadaqa request, confirm the academic record to be verified and follow the current platform instructions. Verification is not a guarantee of recognition for every profession or purpose.

sections.title: Employment-related qualification checks
sections.text: Saudi professional-accreditation guidance addresses qualifications and their relationship to the profession. Confirm whether your occupation and case fall within the relevant programme’s scope.

sections.title: A trade test is another question
sections.text: A practical skills examination and verification of academic or experience records should not be treated as the same service. Ask which evidence or examination is actually requested.

sections.title: Before opening an application
sections.text: Have the qualification title, awarding institution, profession and recipient’s written instruction available. Keep personal account access private and verify the official route before payment.

author: SK Attestation Services
